job.title: Executive Assistant & Office Manager | Creative Agency
job.description:
Executive Assistant & Office Manager | Creative Agency | Full-time

The ultimate organiser. The behind-the-scenes powerhouse. The person who makes it all happen. Our client is looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant & Office Manager

They're a dynamic, fast-paced creative business, who make great work, deliver big ideas and where no two days are ever quite the same. They need someone who can keep up!
This is a varied, hands-on role combining high-level executive support to the agency founders and ownership of the day-to-day running of the agency. From managing diaries and coordinating travel to keeping the office humming, organising team events and making sure everything is where it needs to be, you'll be across it all.

What you'll be doing:
  • Providing executive support to the two founders,  including diary management, meetings, travel and expenses.
  • Keeping the day-to-day operations of the agency running smoothly.
  • Taking ownership of the office environment, suppliers, facilities, equipment and general administration.
  • Coordinating meetings, client visits, catering and agency events.
  • Supporting onboarding, team activities and the little things that make a workplace great.
  • Managing invoices, office budgets and general administration.
  • Being the go-to person for the team and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Spotting what needs doing before anyone has to ask.
What we're looking for
  • Experience in an EA, Office Manager or combined EA/Office Management role.
  • Exceptional organisational skills and an ability to juggle multiple priorities.
  • A proactive, can-do attitude. You're a natural problem solver who makes things happen.
  • Confidence communicating with everyone from senior leaders and clients to suppliers and the wider team.
  • Great attention to detail and the ability to think several steps ahead.
  • Someone who is comfortable working autonomously and taking ownership.
  • A positive, personable nature and a great sense of humour.
  • Flexibility, initiative and a willingness to roll up your sleeves.
The kind of person we're after:

 You're the person everyone relies on. You're organised without being rigid, professional without being corporate and can switch seamlessly between managing an executive's calendar, sorting out a last-minute request and organising the next team celebration.

You thrive on variety, enjoy being around creative people and take genuine pride in making things run effortlessly behind the scenes.
If you're resourceful, energetic, love a challenge and want to be part of a creative business where there's always something happening, we'd love to hear from you.

Come and make yourself indispensable.

Sheryn Small | Lead Talent Partner | iknowho.com.au

job.title: Account Manager
job.description:
Account Manager| Highly awarded Creative Agency | Surry Hills | Up to $90k inc
 
Highly awarded creative agency is seeking a superstar Account Manager to join their successful business. The agency is in an exciting growth phase, picking up business across a range of sectors, from corporates to start-ups in the Fashion, Retail, FMCG, NFP, Tech and FMCG sectors. They are looking for a switched on Account Manager to join their team.

The opportunity:
  
· Be mentored by some of the best suits in the business
· Integrated work, TVC, OOH, digital, social to store design
· Work-life balance - opportunity to work from home 2 days per week
· Join an agency in an exciting growth phase that has won Emerging Agency and Effie awards
· Amazing opportunity to learn and grow
  
About you:
  
· Minimum 1-2 year screative agency experience
· Know how a creative agency operates: WIPs, status reports, budgets, supplier management, quoting, invoicing, client management, briefs, and deadlines 
· You like taking ownership of your work and have great initiative
· Great at building strong client and internal working relationships
· Strong communicator, with the tenacity and ability to ‘make things happen’
· A willingness to wear multiple hats when required
· Working holiday visas welcome

Don't miss this terrific opportunity & apply today

Sheryn Small | Lead Talent Consultant | iknowho.com.au

job.title: Account Director | Contract
job.description:
Freelance Account Director | $500-550 inc | Sydney North
  
This independent agency is looking for an Account Director to help deliver 3 brand launch campaigns for a major Betting & Gaming client.  Large integrated campaign experience is mandatory as this campaign will launch across both traditional and on-line channels.
  
The contract will run until Christmas but has the potential to extend or even go permanent
  
You’ll work closely and be mentored by an experienced Client Service Director and will have ability to work with an internal production and content arm.

What's in it for you?
  • Work on brand launch campaigns with big media budgets
  • Be mentored by a CSD
  • Tight-knit team culture
  • Good transport links (Metro)
  • Hybrid working 4 days in the office and 1 day from home
What do you need? 
  • Local creative agency experience
  • Account Director level or beyond experience
  • Integrated experience including TVC, OOH, Digital, Social, and Content
  • Switched on, great under pressure, with a tonne of initiative
  • Team player
  • Immediately available
Sheryn Small | Lead Talent Consultant | iknowho.com.au
